prompt: What is the name of the steel roller coaster that most recently lost its title as the tallest operating steel roller coaster in the world?
answer: **Kingda Ka**, the steel launch coaster at Six Flags Great Adventure in New Jersey. It lost the title after closing permanently in November 2024.
